analytic_checks.name: Gaussian UI harmonic curve and gradient
Gaussian UI linear CV coordinate rescaling
Radial generic PMF contains r^2 Jacobian

fixes: UI validates finite scalar streams, beta, centers, positive stiffness and increasing finite grid; common scalar stiffness is supported.
Removed dimensionful 1e-20 variance cutoff to preserve coordinate rescaling invariance.
Changed correlated PMF bootstrap block target from ceil(g) to ceil(5*g), capped at floor(N/2).
Report requested/actual block lengths, cap, block counts, finite/limited/unavailable status.
Withhold errors and confidence intervals when fewer than four points or no resolved independent variation is available; propagate unavailable status into joint rate uncertainty.
scope_limits: Analytic and quadrature tests establish numerical consistency on specified distributions, not convergence of a molecular PES.
AR1 error oracle uses the Gaussian delta method and exact finite-N mean covariance; finite-N higher-order terms are not included.
Five-g blocks are a conservative heuristic, not universal coverage or proof of hidden-mode mixing.
Histogram PMFs estimate bin-averaged density; point-potential barriers differ at finite bin width.
Gaussian UI still assumes Gaussian biased-window densities and may be biased for non-Gaussian windows.
Physical P, timestep, sampling, CV and channel convergence must be established separately.

test_execution.command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_pmf_1d_accuracy.py tests/test_mbar_rate_analysis.py tests/test_rate_mbar_backend.py tests/test_rate_workflows.py
